package.author: Toan Nguyen
package.description: A fast, lightweight native desktop application for exploring, monitoring, and managing Kubernetes clusters.

en-US.author: Toan Nguyen
en-US.description: A fast, lightweight native desktop application for exploring, monitoring, and managing Kubernetes clusters.
en-US.longDescription: Orbit is a lightweight, native desktop Kubernetes dashboard designed to provide a fast, responsive, and intuitive interface for managing Kubernetes clusters. Built with Rust and Tauri, Orbit ensures low memory footprint, snappy performance, and secure cluster interactions.
en-US.name: Orbit
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
🚀 Features
- feat: add inline replicas and image editing for workloads by @vantoan1511 in #349
- feat: improve ToggleSwitch off-state visibility and theme tokens by @vantoan1511 in #350
- feat: defer tab backend data computations and filters behind async hydration by @vantoan1511 in #352
- feat: add editorial paper ui style preset by @vantoan1511 in #353
🐛 Bug Fixes
- fix: resolve settings page UI flash and layout shift on setting changes by @vantoan1511 in #351
🛠 Maintenance & Refactoring
- chore: release v0.19.1 by @vantoan1511 in #354
Full Changelog: v0.18.2...v0.19.1
